released_drawing_requirements.requirement: Unique part number, drawing number, revision, parent assembly, quantity, handedness, units, release status and authorized sign-off.
Manufacturable views and necessary sections; all controlling dimensions tied to stated datums; critical interfaces referenced to the same coordinate system as the assembly.
Exact material specification, grade, condition and product form; traceability/certification requirements. “Steel” or “aluminum” alone is insufficient.
Cut/blank envelope, machining stock and sequence; formed radii and bend direction; casting/forging/machining route where applicable.
Heat treatment, hardness range, case depth or stress relief when required; otherwise a justified not-applicable designation.
Mating parts, bearing/wheel fits, tolerances, surface finishes, runout/concentricity/alignment and retention requirements where applicable.
Hole locations, diameters, fits, depth, threads and edge conditions, with mating interfaces checked; no scaled-from-rendering holes.
Joint preparation, weld symbols, size/extent, sequence, applicable approved WPS, access and distortion control. Specify inspection/NDT and acceptance criteria where required.
Exact fastener specification, grade, coating, washer/locking arrangement, engagement and approved installation method; torque/preload belongs to the reviewed joint design.
Edge breaks, corrosion protection, masked/mating surfaces, marking and protection during storage.
Exploded/BOM references, assembly order, fixtures, press or alignment procedure, wear adjustment and service/removal access.
Measurable first-article and production checks, instruments/datums, hold/witness points, NDT scope and acceptance values; record form tied to part/serial.
Link to calculation and interface documents governing the part, including relevant load/fatigue/thermal cases; no unsupported rating printed on a part.
Approved substitutions, deviations, rework limits and superseded revisions; unresolved critical items prohibit the fabrication-release stamp.

release_states.meaning: Draft dimensions, candidate materials and calculated interfaces; held fields visible.
Responsible designer signs a defined first-article scope and process/test plan. This is not permission for public operation.
First-article findings, critical interfaces, manufacturing processes and acceptance checks have been accepted by the responsible professionals.
Actual manufactured item conforms to its released revision, or approved deviations are recorded.
The integrated train/site passes the separately approved commissioning and required operational approvals.

work_sequence.title: Freeze the local wheelset/brake design basis
inputs: Existing upper coach masses and 3K torque cases
holds: Final wheel/rail profile and accepted loads
work_sequence.allows_next: Geometric studies and draft manufacturing drawings may continue with conspicuous held fields.

work_sequence.title: Develop the wheel, axle and bearing stack
outputs: Fit, finish and NDT schedule draft
holds: Material/heat treatment, fatigue, fits and wheel/rail compatibility sign-off
work_sequence.allows_next: Use candidate envelopes to position the mechanical brake; do not machine wheel/axle seats.

work_sequence.title: Develop the brake carrier and actuator linkage
inputs: Selected friction system geometry and properties
outputs: Stroke/clearance/tolerance calculation and attachment load path
holds: OEM interface data and engineer acceptance of forces, joints and wear travel
work_sequence.allows_next: Build an explicitly released non-load-bearing fit mockup if separately defined; no passenger-service hardware release.

work_sequence.title: Release and test one controlled first article
inputs: Instrumented test plan with numerical acceptance criteria
holds: Prototype-build release; test equipment and witnessed results
work_sequence.allows_next: Revise the drawing package from actual findings before production release.

work_sequence.title: Complete the bogie around the verified interfaces
outputs: Custom bogie frame and support detail set
holds: Vehicle dynamics, fatigue and support interface acceptance
work_sequence.allows_next: Coordinate 3J frame revision and 3M coupling loads without silently replacing the earlier studies.

work_sequence.title: Continue the existing subsystem order
outputs: Custom coupling, locomotive, coach-body, HVAC/electrical, accessible-boarding, track and station drawing families
work_sequence.allows_next: Develop independent subsystems while one interface awaits external evidence.

work_sequence.title: Coordinate, procure, fabricate, install and commission
inputs: Accepted subsystem interfaces and signed release packages
holds: Actual professional releases, purchase authorization and test evidence
work_sequence.allows_next: Production and passenger operation occur only after their distinct gates; a desktop phase completion does not pass them.

responsibility.engineering: Responsible discipline engineer accepts loads, materials, fatigue, geometry, tolerances, joints and acceptance limits; integrator owns cross-subsystem compatibility.
responsibility.fabrication: Qualified shop owns capability, process plan, fixtures and actual conformity records; it does not close a design hold by choosing a convenient dimension.
responsibility.specialist: Wheel/axle machining, heat treatment, interference assembly, brake validation and specified NDT go to suitably capable specialists under released procedures.
responsibility.farm_crew: Farm crew can perform the released work matching its qualifications, training and equipment: fit mockups, preparation, finishing, designated assembly and supervised track work. Safety-critical work is assigned by demonstrated capability, not by who owns the shop.
responsibility.inspection: Designated inspector records actual material certificates, dimensions, weld/NDT and test results; no acceptance result is prefilled.
responsibility.owner: Owner approves business choices and separately authorizes purchases/outreach. Owner approval is not a substitute for engineering release.
